subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) Then his father told him to quote some lines from the book. (b) He was born in Barishal in 1833. (c) The boy could quote the lines thoroughly and his father became astonished. (d) All of you have heard the name of Sher-e-Bangla A.K. Fazlul Haque. (e) Sher-e-Bangla replied that he had already memorised the book. (f) Then he entere’d the room and asked him the reason of his tearing off the pages. (g) Just at that moment, his father was passing by the room and noticed it. (h) One day while studying, he was tearing off the pages of his books.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d b h g f e a c
